final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT g.throws, g.cnt, 1.0*g.cnt/t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s WHERE share IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_diff FROM k
